experimental_ease: reviewed_workable_route; kinetics/yield not inferred from deltaG alone

route_binding.model_scope: 4-methylbenzyl local site on a preformed polymer

conditions.reactive_form: 10H-phenothiazine with NaH; deprotonated N is the intended nucleophile
conditions.counterions: Na+ reagent and chloride-derived salt; NaCl/H2 shown only as balanced stoichiometry, not a measured phase/speciation model

evidence.evidence_scope: Wright and Jin, J. Org. Chem. 1989, 54, 965-968, Scheme I/p.966 and experimental p.967: N-attachment of unsubstituted phenothiazine to chloromethylated polystyrene beads; chemical oxidation and reduction of the attached core. The exact capped product is a local model of that connection.
evidence.support_evidence_class: demonstrated bead attachment class; capped molecular model distinct
evidence.precursor_access_scope: Commercial phenothiazine identified in the original general procedures; not a current vendor/procurement check
evidence.source_reported_product_characterization: Washed/dried N-substituted polymer; nitrogen analysis calculated 3.34%, found 3.36%. Reported mass-based yield is not a measured loading or conversion for our beads.
evidence.redox_retention_scope: Subsequent SbCl5 oxidation in CH2Cl2 and reduction during metal-complex oxidation support retained redox function; not reversible battery cycling or MeCN validation
evidence.limitations: Single primary report. Our bead crosslinking, swelling, accessibility, conversion and loading are unknown. Solid/solution salt activities, hydrogen chemical potential, exact capped-graft G, MeCN redox accuracy and operating-state interactions remain unresolved. No ring-substituted or ether-linked route is admitted by this evidence.

actual_condition_stoichiometry.source_scope: Stoichiometric local-site representation of the reported NaH reaction; salt phases and gas/solution activities are not quantified by this graph check
